title: Cut lore's GitHub Release as an executed, refusing step once latest is verified, not a printed checklist item (pair symmetry with quest, OPAG-646)
description: Dispatched by opum-agent under OPAG-646 (pair symmetry), 2026-09-27. Today lore's GitHub Release is a line in scripts/publish-release.sh's printed closing checklist (item 2 at ~line 288: 'Cut a non-draft, non-prerelease GitHub Release for v$VERSION ... gh release create'), carried out by hand. Releases are current through v0.11.0 (gh release list, 2026-09-27: v0.11.0, v0.9.3, v0.9.2), but only because someone remembered; quest's lagged to v0.6.0 unnoticed the same way. quest-cli is making its own executed (QCLI-398, relayed by opum-agent as under review, not read here): promote-release.mjs --promote cuts the GitHub Release from the CHANGELOG section once latest is verified, and refuses before any tag moves if the section is missing. Lore should do the same, in the same place in the flow, with the design paired with quest-cli. Sequencing: under LCLI-621 (the held Article 3.5 amendment, ODOC-302) the point where latest is set becomes the final @opum-ai/lore X publish rather than a dist-tag move, so this lands with or after LCLI-621 rather than being built twice. Overlap: LCLI-618 AC2 lists 'GitHub Release' among the post-latest checklist items; once this lands that item is executed, not printed.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The design is paired with quest-cli: the step location, the CHANGELOG section it reads, the release title and notes shape, and the refusal conditions match QCLI-398 or each difference is named and agreed, recorded on this task with the quest-cli ref read
lore's promote step (promote-latest.mjs, or its LCLI-621 successor) refuses BEFORE moving or publishing anything onto latest when CHANGELOG.md has no ## [X] section for the version being promoted

Once latest is verified for X, the step creates a non-draft, non-prerelease GitHub Release for vX from that CHANGELOG section; it is idempotent (an existing release for vX with the same notes is not duplicated or silently rewritten) and a failure is reported, not swallowed

publish-release.sh (and LCLI-618's post-latest checklist) no longer asks a human to cut the release; tests pin the refusal, the created release's shape via a stubbed gh, and the absence of the printed item
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0; a reviewer pass covers the scripts/ change

plan: 1. PHASE 1 (done in this pass, tracker only): pair the design with quest-cli QCLI-398 read by ref at quest-cli 0f671906e7487b35db9441bfff81b2f7832876fa; record MATCH/DIFFER per point in the DESIGN PAIRING note. No code.

2. PHASE 2 GATE: start only after LCLI-617 (validateRecord in scripts/promote-latest.mjs) lands on origin/dev. Merge origin/dev into feat/LCLI-622-executed-github-release and re-read promote-latest.mjs main(), since every line number in the note moves. Phase 2 exclusive file scope is exactly: scripts/github-release.mjs (new), scripts/promote-latest.mjs, scripts/publish-release.sh (comment only), test/github-release.test.ts (new), test/promote-latest.test.ts, docs/runbooks/release-publishing.md, CHANGELOG.md, .quest/tasks/LCLI-622.json.

3. scripts/github-release.mjs (new), mirroring quest's module and export names: RELEASE_REPOSITORY = github.com/opum-ai/lore-cli (built from pair-receipt.mjs RECEIPT_HOST and OWN_REPOSITORY); changelogSection(changelog, version) matching ^## \[X\](?:\s.*)?$ and ending at the next '## ' line or at the trailing link-reference block ([...]: url) at end of file, trimmed, null when absent or empty; releaseTitle -> 'Lore CLI X' (keeping quest's never-published suffix rule); releaseNotesFor(version, {changelogPath}); ensureGitHubRelease({version, notes, title, latest=true, dryRun=false, execFile}) returning {ok, action, detail}, never throwing. Reads with gh release view vX -R <repo> --json tagName,body,isDraft,isPrerelease; creates with gh release create vX -R <repo> --verify-tag --title --notes-file <tmp> --latest=true|false; existing + same notes -> gh release edit vX -R <repo> --latest; existing + different notes, draft or prerelease -> ok:false, never edited. JSDoc types checked by tsconfig.scripts.json (no .d.mts). Standalone CLI --version X [--create] [--not-latest] whose main RETURNS an exit code (0 ok, 1 refused/failed, 2 usage), no process.exit.

4. scripts/promote-latest.mjs: (a) new pre-move step after step 8 (the X probe) and BEFORE the dry-run return and the record write: releaseNotesFor(version) -> refuse (return 1, 'Nothing has moved') when no non-empty ## [X] section; then ensureGitHubRelease({dryRun:true, execFile: run}) on BOTH --dry-run and --promote -> refuse (return 1) when !ok (gh missing/logged out/offline/unreadable, or an existing vX whose notes differ or that is a draft/prerelease). Dry run prints the planned line. (b) after step 11 (verifyTags + verifyFinalLauncher) and before the README read-back: rm the private npmrc dir and clear npmrcDir (the finally stays as a backstop), then ensureGitHubRelease({execFile: run}) and report the outcome. (c) exit: README read-back not PASSED OR release not cut -> README_READBACK_EXIT (3), widening its documented meaning to 'promotion complete and verified, a post-latest step did not complete; do NOT roll back'; the failure message names the repair command node scripts/github-release.mjs --version X --create. (d) postLatestChecklist item 2 reports the executed outcome (created / already existed, marked latest / NOT CUT + repair command) instead of the printed gh release create instruction. (e) header comment steps 11-12 and exit-code block, and the LCLI-622 comment at postLatestChecklist, updated. --rollback path unchanged: it never reaches a release call.

5. scripts/publish-release.sh: comment-only edit at the closing-checklist block (~lines 262-267) saying the GitHub Release is now cut by promote-latest.mjs, not printed. No behaviour change; test/publish-release-script.test.ts already asserts the staging checklist carries no gh release line and stays unchanged.

6. test/github-release.test.ts (new), quest's cases with a stubbed execFile: extraction (dated bracketed heading, 0.1.1 vs 0.1.10, absent/empty/Unreleased -> null, last section excludes the link-reference block, every ## [X] heading in the real CHANGELOG yields notes), title, create argv (-R pinned, --verify-tag, --latest=true/false, notes file), exists+same notes -> edit --latest only, exists+different notes -> ok:false and no edit/create, draft/prerelease -> ok:false, dry run reads only, failed create/edit returned not thrown, unreadable view refuses, 'release not found' in message only reads as absent. Plus the measured fact that trim(existing v0.11.0 body) equals the section, as a fixture-free comment, not a network test.

7. test/promote-latest.test.ts: the in-memory world gains a gh release view/create/edit responder. Pin by OBSERVED CALL ORDER through main(), not source layout: missing ## [X] refuses with zero npm writes and no record file (AC2), on --dry-run and --promote; unusable gh refuses before any write on both paths; dry run issues only the view; --promote issues create after the last latest write and after verifyFinalLauncher's reads, and after the npmrc dir is gone (assert the dir no longer exists when the stub sees the create); --rollback issues no gh release call; failed create -> exit 3 with 'do NOT roll back' and the repair command, still running the README read-back; checklist no longer contains 'gh release create v' (AC4) and the runbook-item test's step list is updated to the executed wording.

8. docs/runbooks/release-publishing.md section 3 item 8 step 2: executed, not manual; what the refusal means; the repair command; and that --rollback leaves GitHub marking vX latest, with the gh release edit v<prior> --latest remedy (quest's reviewer finding 2). CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] entry.

9. Gates: bun test, bun run typecheck (both tsconfigs), bun run lore check from source; lint. Mutation checks with PREDICTED subsets: drop the escaped brackets from the heading regex -> only the bracketed-heading extraction tests red; move the preflight into the dry-run branch -> only the --promote gh-refusal ordering test red; move the npmrc rm after the cut -> only the cleanup-order test red. Record exact counts.

10. opum-workflow:reviewer pass on the scripts/ change (CLAUDE.md: a gate that is wrong fails only during a release), fix findings, open the PR to dev, check ACs only with evidence. Record honestly that the post-promote cut first runs live at the next lore promotion.
implementationNotes: CHECK BEFORE IMPLEMENTING (opum-agent, cross-session, 2026-09-27): quest-cli's reviewer found two defects in QCLI-398's executed release step, both fixed before merge; reference opum-ai/quest-cli scripts/github-release.mjs and promote-release.mjs on main at 06189deb (commit resolved by API here; github-release.mjs blob 89c24028). (1) A failed release step left the npm token file on disk because process.exit skipped the finally that deletes it -- cut the release AFTER credential cleanup, and never exit from inside the try. (2) --promote did not check gh works before moving tags -- the step must refuse before ANY tag or latest move if gh is unusable, as the dry run does. Both are candidate ACs for this task when it unholds.

DESIGN PAIRING (QCLI-398 @0f671906)

QUEST SIDE, read by ref through gh api contents?ref=, never from a sibling working tree. quest-cli commit 0f671906e7487b35db9441bfff81b2f7832876fa ("chore(QCLI-399): recycle handoff note (#356)"). Blob ids recomputed from the fetched bytes, each equal to the tree entry: scripts/github-release.mjs 89c24028d87b7a1e467ff0c8d54c2b3e7679ad54 (223 lines, the same blob opum-agent cited at 06189deb); scripts/github-release.d.mts c6124ab0528fba474397aa09ba6868dec76ff3de; scripts/promote-release.mjs 786f93724339b3baa6cddeab90adaa226dad3ffc (963 lines); test/qcli398-github-release.test.ts c531f91bb23210ee2e44537a0a5200c2f9e293b6 (18 tests); .quest/completed/QCLI-398.json d249ca49256d196c0e8362f580778637f4a59d4a (Done).
LORE SIDE read at origin/dev 84f60e84: scripts/promote-latest.mjs (main() ~1071-1518, postLatestChecklist 990), scripts/publish-release.sh (print_closing_checklist 253-294), CHANGELOG.md.

CORRECTION TO THIS RECORD'S DESCRIPTION: publish-release.sh no longer prints a GitHub Release item. LCLI-618 moved it; the only printed instruction is now postLatestChecklist item 2 in promote-latest.mjs (plus runbook section 3 item 8 step 2). test/publish-release-script.test.ts:1676-1677 already asserts the staging checklist carries no gh release line. So AC4's publish-release.sh half is already true; phase 2 touches that script's comment only.

(a) STEP LOCATION -- MATCH. Two call sites, as quest: (1) a pre-move preflight, run on --dry-run AND --promote, placed after lore's last pre-move check (step 8, the X probe; quest's equivalent is checkFinalLauncherSlot) and before the dry-run return and the record write; (2) the cut, after latest is verified -- lore's step 11 (verifyTags on all seven AND verifyFinalLauncher), which under LCLI-621 is the point where the final @opum-ai/lore X publish has landed and been read back -- and BEFORE the README read-back, as quest cuts before its readme read-back so the read-back's wait (up to REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS, default 1800s here) cannot delay it. --rollback never reaches either call: MATCH.

(b) CHANGELOG SECTION -- DIFFER (format only). Quest matches ^## X(?:\s.*)?$; lore must match ^## \[X\](?:\s.*)?$ with X regex-escaped, because lore's CHANGELOG is Keep a Changelog: all 27 version headings are "## [X] - YYYY-MM-DD" (checked: every "## " line in the file is a version heading or [Unreleased], so nothing inside the file's one code fence is mistaken for a section end). End of section: next line starting "## " (MATCH), PLUS lore's last section also stops at the trailing link-reference block ("[Unreleased]: https://...", "[0.1.0]: https://...", lines 2777-2778), which quest's rule would fold into the 0.1.0 body. Trimmed, heading excluded, null when absent or empty, "Unreleased" never a version: MATCH. Source is this checkout's CHANGELOG.md, as quest (MATCH); the v0.11.0 tag's own CHANGELOG carries "## [0.11.0] - 2026-09-27" too, so the two agree today.

(c) TITLE AND NOTES SHAPE -- MATCH. Title "Lore CLI X" (quest's releaseTitle comment says it copied lore's). Quest's "(tagged, never published)" suffix rule is kept for symmetry, though no lore promotion can hit it. Notes = the trimmed section, written to a temp notes file with a trailing newline, --notes-file, --verify-tag (never creates a tag), -R github.com/opum-ai/lore-cli (host pinned, as lore's existing gh calls pin it via RECEIPT_HOST + OWN_REPOSITORY), --latest=true. Measured: the hand-cut v0.11.0 release body, trimmed, is byte-equal to the trimmed [0.11.0] section (8683 bytes each), so automation reproduces the current hand practice. Lore has 10 releases and 10 tags (counts only, not matched per tag), so no backfill is owed here, unlike quest.

(d) REFUSAL CONDITIONS AND WHEN. All refusals below fire at the preflight, before the record write and before ANY dist-tag move or the X publish, on --dry-run and --promote alike, returning exit 1 with "Nothing has moved":
  d1 no non-empty ## [X] section -- MATCH (this is AC2).
  d2 gh release view fails for any reason other than "release not found" (gh missing, logged out, offline, no access) -- MATCH.
  d3 vX exists with notes that differ from the section -- DIFFER, see (e).
  d4 vX exists as a draft or a prerelease -- DIFFER. AC3 requires a non-draft, non-prerelease release, and quest's step would mark such a release latest without looking. Refused with the remedy printed; never edited.
  After the move, nothing can refuse: a failed create or edit is reported (f). Honest limit shared with quest: the preflight is a read, so it proves gh is installed, authenticated and can see the repo, not that the token may create a release; a read-only token is found only at the cut, after latest moved, and is reported, not swallowed.

(e) IDEMPOTENCY. No release: create (MATCH). Exists with the same notes: never recreated, never re-noted, marked latest with gh release edit vX --latest (MATCH). Exists with DIFFERENT notes: DIFFER. Quest never reads the existing body, so a stale or hand-edited release is silently certified as done. Lore reads body,isDraft,isPrerelease in the same view call, compares after trim and CRLF->LF, and on a mismatch returns ok:false, never edits: at the preflight that refuses the promotion before anything moves, which is when the operator can still fix either side. Reason: AC3 names "with the same notes", and the fleet rule that a check gating on an artifact that carries content must compare the content, not the artifact's existence. Recommended back to quest-cli as an addition rather than a lore-only variant.

(f) FAILURE REPORTING. Returned as {ok, action, detail}, never thrown; one-line gh stderr in the detail; a failed cut prints "NOT cut ... latest moved and is verified -- do NOT roll back for this" plus the repair command node scripts/github-release.mjs --version X --create; the README read-back still runs after a failed cut: all MATCH. EXIT CODE: DIFFER. Quest exits 1. Lore will exit 3 (README_READBACK_EXIT), widening that code's documented meaning to "promotion COMPLETE and verified, but a post-latest step (README read-back or GitHub Release) did not complete; do NOT roll back". Reason: lore's exit 1 is documented as "refused or failed; what moved, if anything, and the remedy are printed", the class that can call for --rollback, and LCLI-616 created 3 precisely so a complete promotion never exits in that class. Quest has no such code because its read-back is report-only (QCLI-400) and exits 0. One code for both post-latest failures also needs no precedence rule when both fail; the messages say which.

(g) QUEST'S TWO REVIEWER DEFECTS, mapped.
  g1 cleanup ordering -- MATCH in guarantee, DIFFER in mechanism. Lore's defect-1 mechanism cannot occur: promote-latest.mjs main() never calls process.exit (it returns codes; the entry point sets process.exitCode), so its finally (line ~1514, which removes npmrcDir and artifactDir) always runs. But the ordering guarantee still has to be built: the cut would otherwise sit inside that try, with the Keychain/NPM_TOKEN npmrc still on disk. Quest cuts after the finally; lore cannot, because the README read-back needs final.path inside artifactDir, which the same finally deletes, and it returns 0/3 from inside the try. So lore removes the private npmrc dir explicitly right after step 11 and before the cut, clearing npmrcDir so the finally stays a harmless backstop. gh never sees the npm credential either way (only npmEnv carries npm_config_userconfig; gh runs with the process env); the OTP path writes no file.
  g2 gh unusable -- MATCH. Preflight (d2) on both paths, before the record write and any move. Lore's promote already calls gh before anything moves (tag peel, Release run read, artifact download), but those prove API reads only; the release view is the explicit check.

(h) DRY RUN -- MATCH. Runs d1 and the gh read, prints "GitHub Release: would create release vX "Lore CLI X" (N bytes of notes), marked latest" or "exists; would mark it latest", writes nothing; lore's existing "would ..." lines gain it.

(i) CODE AND TEST SHAPE. MATCH: a scripts/github-release.mjs with quest's export names (RELEASE_REPOSITORY, changelogSection, releaseTitle, releaseNotesFor, ensureGitHubRelease with an injectable execFile, the same action vocabulary), doubling as the repair/backfill CLI --version X [--create] [--not-latest]; unit tests with a stubbed gh execFile, same cases. DIFFER, all from existing lore convention, none of them a behaviour: (i1) types by JSDoc under tsconfig.scripts.json, no .d.mts; (i2) the CLI main returns an exit code instead of calling process.exit (0/1/2 as quest's), the same rule that makes g1 structural here; (i3) ordering is pinned by driving promote-latest.mjs main() through its injectable runner and asserting the OBSERVED gh/npm call sequence (and that the npmrc dir is gone when the create is seen), rather than quest's source-layout indexOf tests. Lore can because main() already runs end to end against an in-memory registry and GitHub (test/promote-latest.test.ts); quest's main is not injectable. Actions gain "notes-differ" and "not-final" for d3/d4.

DIFFER SUMMARY for quest-cli: b (bracketed Keep-a-Changelog heading; link-reference block ends the last section), d3/e (compare existing notes; refuse pre-move on mismatch), d4 (refuse an existing draft/prerelease), f (exit 3 not 1: lore already reserves 3 for complete-but-post-latest-incomplete), g1 mechanism (explicit npmrc removal before the cut, since the cut cannot move after lore's finally), i1-i3 (JSDoc types, exit-code-returning main, call-order tests). Items worth proposing to quest: e and d4.
DESIGN QUESTIONS FOR THE ORCHESTRATOR: none found by the two-question test. Every DIFFER is internal to lore's release tooling and reversible with no migration; no other repository reads promote-latest.mjs's exit codes. The closest is (f), a pair-symmetry divergence opum-agent may want to see, not a contract change.

PAIRING AGREED, PHASE 2 NOT STARTED (lore-cli session handoff, 2026-09-28). quest-cli agreed, cross-session: the lore-only differences 1 (Keep a Changelog heading, stopping at the link-reference lines), 4 (exit 3 for a post-latest failure), 5 (explicit npmrc removal before the cut, with finally as a backstop) and 6 (conventions) are accepted as lore-only. Differences 2 (an existing vX with different notes is refused, never edited) and 3 (an existing draft or prerelease vX is refused) were ADOPTED by quest as QCLI-401, opum-ai/quest-cli#360, head 06fa623a, MERGED as 93fca842 (read by API). QCLI-401's view call: gh release view vX --json tagName,body,isDraft,isPrerelease. It fails closed on isDraft/isPrerelease !== false, checked BEFORE notes. Notes are compared as replace(/\r\n/g,'\n').trim() on both sides. Unparseable or non-object output, or a missing string body, gives ok:false. Nothing is ever edited. Lore adopts #360 at 06fa623a as the spec for these existing-release states. OWED TO QUEST-CLI: QCLI-401 AC6 stays open until lore sends its LCLI-622 PR head SHA plus a verdict table covering draft, prerelease, differing notes, unparseable/non-object/missing-body output, and a missing key. WHY PHASE 2 WAITS: it edits scripts/promote-latest.mjs, which LCLI-631 is changing now (planPromotion). Exclusive file scope means phase 2 starts after LCLI-631 lands, on a fresh branch from origin/dev, re-reading main() because line numbers moved (LCLI-617 and LCLI-631 both changed that file). The plan above is phase 2's scope. Also the CHANGELOG entry, which the parent adds at landing.

PHASE 2 IMPLEMENTED (implementer, 2026-09-28), branch feat/LCLI-622-executed-github-release from origin/dev 640195ec (LCLI-617 and LCLI-631 both in). Commits 81b011d5 (feature) and ea6a6810 (a test fix found by mutation M4). Pushed; no PR opened. The reviewer pass (plan step 10) belongs to the parent.

WHAT LANDED. scripts/github-release.mjs (new) mirrors quest-cli's module read by ref at 06fa623a (opum-ai/quest-cli#360, merged 93fca842; the module is byte-identical at both refs, sha256 09efd481...). Same export names (RELEASE_REPOSITORY, changelogSection, releaseTitle, releaseNotesFor, ensureGitHubRelease) and the same action vocabulary. Every existing-release state follows #360 exactly: view with tagName,body,isDraft,isPrerelease; isDraft/isPrerelease must be strictly false, checked BEFORE the notes; notes compared as replace(/\r\n/g,'\n').trim() on both sides; unparseable or non-object output, or a missing or non-string body, gives ok:false; nothing is ever edited except --latest on an exact match. Plus REPAIR_COMMAND and a main() that returns 0/1/2. promote-latest.mjs: new step 9, a pre-move preflight after step 8 (the X probe) and before the dry-run return and the record write, on --dry-run and --promote alike. It refuses with exit 1 and "Nothing has moved" on an unreadable CHANGELOG, no non-empty ## [X] section (AC2), or ensureGitHubRelease({dryRun:true}) ok:false. New step 13, after step 7 (verifyTags + verifyFinalLauncher) and before the README read-back: it rm's the private npmrc dir and clears npmrcDir (the finally stays as the backstop), then cuts. A failed cut prints a NOT CUT block with do NOT roll back and the repair command, the read-back still runs, and it exits 3 (README_READBACK_EXIT, whose documented meaning is widened). postLatestChecklist item 2 now reports DONE or NOT CUT plus the outcome, and gives the repair command only when the release was not cut. It no longer prints gh release create. The header steps are renumbered 1-14. --rollback is unchanged and makes no gh release call. publish-release.sh: comment only. Runbook section 3 items 7 and 8, plus the Rollback section (a rollback leaves GitHub marking vX latest; remedy gh release edit v<prior> -R github.com/opum-ai/lore-cli --latest).

PLAN WRONG AGAINST THE CODE (each a scope extension, all necessary):
(1) Plan step 3 said "no .d.mts". But test/ imports scripts under strict tsc through .d.mts companions (launcher-equivalence, pair-receipt, promote-latest, version-parity all have one). So scripts/github-release.d.mts is new, and scripts/promote-latest.d.mts gained postLatestChecklist's githubRelease field and main's changelogPath option. The JSDoc in the .mjs is still checked by tsconfig.scripts.json.
(2) test/lcli631-promote-refuses-older-or-prerelease.test.ts was not in scope. Its 3 success cases drive main() to completion, and a CHANGELOG section plus a gh release responder are now required. (3) main() gained a changelogPath option (default: this checkout's CHANGELOG.md), because the test harness's version 5.6.7 has no section in the real file.
(4) Pairing note (i) proposed actions "notes-differ" and "not-final". Once lore adopted #360 as the spec, those became quest's "none", so the verdict tables compare cell for cell.
(5) Plan step 9's M1 prediction ("only the bracketed-heading extraction tests red") cannot hold. The main() integration tests go through the real extraction on a Keep-a-Changelog fixture, so dropping the brackets refuses every promotion at step 9. See the gates note.
FIRST LIVE RUN: the post-promote cut has NOT run live. Every create/edit in this change ran against a stubbed gh. The first real cut happens at the next lore promotion. Measured live (read-only, 2026-09-28): gh release view v0.11.0 returns isDraft false, isPrerelease false, and a body that, trimmed, is byte-equal to changelogSection(CHANGELOG.md,"0.11.0").body (8683 bytes each), so an existing v0.11.0 reads as an exact match.

QCLI-401 AC6 VERDICT TABLE, owed to quest-cli, at lore-cli ea6a6810 (branch feat/LCLI-622-executed-github-release; PR head SHA to follow once the parent opens it). Columns: ensureGitHubRelease({version:"1.2.3", notes:"Notes.", latest:true}) -> ok/action [gh verbs issued], for dryRun true | dryRun false. Every row is asserted by test/github-release.test.ts "the QCLI-401 AC6 verdict table", one test per row per mode (38 tests).
- release absent: ok would-create [view] | ok created [view+create]
- exact match: ok would-mark-latest [view] | ok marked-latest [view+edit --latest]
- CRLF-only difference (body "\r\nNotes.\r\n\r\n"): ok would-mark-latest [view] | ok marked-latest [view+edit]
- draft: FAIL none [view] | FAIL none [view]
- prerelease: FAIL none [view] | FAIL none [view]
- draft AND differing notes: FAIL none [view] | FAIL none [view]. Reported as "draft", because state is checked before notes.
- differing notes: FAIL none [view] | FAIL none [view]
- unparseable output, "not json" and "": FAIL none [view] | FAIL none [view]
- non-object output, [], null and "a string": FAIL none [view] | FAIL none [view]

With latest:false (a backfill), an exact match gives ok exists [view] and an absent release is created with --latest=false. Tested.
